hooks.name: Log Kiro usage after each task
hooks.description: After each spec task, remind the agent to append a short entry to docs/KIRO_USAGE.md for the hackathon write-up.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Append one concise row to the Log table in docs/KIRO_USAGE.md with today's date, which Kiro feature was used (spec, steering, hook, MCP, power, PBT), and the result. Skip if nothing notable happened.
